items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability, codenamed StyleSmuggler by Sansec, allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code by abusing Magento's template system through PHP code injection. Adobe released an emergency hotfix as it was actively exploited in the wild to deploy Rust backdoors and PHP web shells.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.
